essence: Both prīti and brahma conjunctions support longevity and love, with brahma being especially auspicious.
The kaulava, bālava, and especially vaṇija karaṇas are most excellent.
Worship of a maiden precedes worship of the eternal goddess.
Worship should be performed with ghee and other accessories, especially flowers and incense.
One should perform the hunting narrative there for three days.
